guard/30874.htm.text: Guard Aldis: If you follow the road a short way to the west, you'll be able to see a giant tower so tall it seems to pierce the sky. That is said to be a tower built by some king of the ancient kingdom... It is called the Tower of Insolence ...

links.text: Ask in detail about the Tower of Insolence.
